name: astra-luna-command-center
description: GPT-6 Astra command center: pack bounded execution packets, dispatch to gpt-5.6-luna workers or an OpenAI-compatible DIY custom model (astra-Diy), ingest hash-bound results, and review/summarize as Astra.

interface.shortDescription: Plan with GPT-6 Astra; execute via gpt-5.6-luna or a custom OpenAI-compatible DIY worker (/astra-Diy).
interface.longDescription: Turns GPT-6 Astra (this Codex session) into a two-tier command center. Astra plans and reviews; workers execute bounded packets (local astra_* agents on gpt-5.6-luna, or the astra-Diy OpenAI-compatible custom model). DIY setup: Base URL + API Key + Model, with connection test and model list fetch; when enabled it replaces only the worker model, never Astra's control-tower role. Settings UI: assets/diy-settings/index.html. Commands: diy-set / diy-show / diy-test / diy-models / diy-settings. Skill: astra-diy. Packets move new -> done -> ingested -> summarized with SHA-256 binding and no silent model/transport fallback.
defaultPrompt: Run /astra-Diy to configure my OpenAI-compatible custom worker (base URL, API key, model).
Run the astra-luna doctor self-check and report DIY vs luna worker route.
Create an execution packet from a spec JSON and dispatch it to the worker.
Show the status of all astra-luna execution packets.
